svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make 2. Barrel: tube 168.3 OD x 6.3 wall, YSt 310, 280 long.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Flanges: two discs 330 OD, 6 mm plate, 40.5 mm centre hole.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rope hole: 14 mm in the right flange, 94 mm above the centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Brake rim: 50 x 6 flat bar rolled to 330 OD, butt welded, welded

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: to the outside face of the left flange, flush with its edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Shaft: C45+QT bar 40 mm, 618 long, ends 296 right and 322 left

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: of the drum middle; right flange outer face 185 right of it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld flanges to barrel all round; weld shaft to both flanges.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Keyways 12 mm wide: 44 long (gear hub), 64 long (ratchet and hub).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Turn the brake rim true on the shaft after welding (0.5 mm).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Galvanise barrel and flanges; mask and grease the shaft ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the shaft runs in the 40 mm flange bearings; 15 mm gap to

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the right cheek, 43 mm to the left. Mass about 23.5 kg.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: spin it on the shaft; the rim runs true within 0.5 mm.
